audit-v1.zip
Zip Archive
Use the attached Skill Auditor to assess both separate target packages under targets/ for their declared workshop-list use. events.json is a legitimate input sample. Identify material defects if present; a sound target can have a clean result. Do not modify either target. You may execute the bundled Python scripts using disposable copies and output files in your analysis workspace. Assess their actual consumer behavior and the contracts they declare.
Worked for 2m 13s
Called tool

Audit complete. I treated the two packages independently, used the bundled Skill Auditor guidance/reporters, exercised the scripts only from disposable copies, and did not modify either target.

Target	Result	Material finding
targets/session-list	Clean for the declared workshop-list use	None found
targets/workshop-list	Defective	Script depends on caller CWD despite explicitly promising unrelated-CWD operation
Material defect — workshop-list

targets/workshop-list/skills/workshop-list/SKILL.md:9 says the command “supports an unrelated caller working directory.” But scripts/list_events.py:11 loads settings as:

Path('references/settings.json')

That resolves against the process working directory, not the installed skill directory.

Using a disposable copy, an unrelated caller directory, and the supplied legitimate events.json:

return code: 1
stderr: error: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: 'references/settings.json'
output file: not created

As a control, running the same copied script with the skill directory itself as CWD succeeds and produces:

Workshop: Lamp clinic — 2026-09-21
Workshop: Radio clinic — 2026-09-24

So this is a demonstrated consumer-visible path-resolution defect, not an input problem. The failure occurs before the promised workshop list is delivered.

session-list is sound on the assessed boundary

Its corresponding script resolves the packaged settings from __file__ (scripts/list_events.py:11), so the package location rather than the caller CWD controls resource lookup. From an unrelated directory with the supplied sample it exited 0 and produced:

Workshop: Lamp clinic — 2026-09-21
Workshop: Radio clinic — 2026-09-24

A filesystem before/after comparison of the disposable execution showed only the caller-selected output file was added. The cancelled “Clock clinic” was omitted; confirmed titles and dates were preserved; the packaged Workshop prefix was used. I found no material contradiction with the declared no-publishing boundary.

The structural checks were also clean for both targets: required skill metadata, naming, references, and script sanity produced no errors. The current Agent Skills specification permits this SKILL.md structure and its compatibility field. 
Agent Skills
 Both packages' Claude manifests are acceptable minimal manifests, and the Codex compatibility layout with skills: "./skills/" remains supported. 
Claude
+1

I did not elevate the reporter's observation that each plugin description is shorter than its skill description into a defect: both package descriptions still accurately advertise the workshop-list capability, and no consumer failure follows from that difference.

Disposition: retain session-list as clean on the requested contract; workshop-list has one material implementation defect at its declared execution boundary. No target files were changed.

ChatGPT can make mistakes. Check important info.

Extra High
